المسألة: This is a grammatical error. In naḥw, «إنْ المخففة» is the technical name for إنْ المخففة من الثقيلة, a particle of emphasis, not a conditional. The conditional إنْ is a separate particle, as is the negative إنْ. With اللهَ in the accusative, the sentence cannot be read as a condition waiting for its apodosis.
البيان: The explanation no longer says the sukūn إنْ is only conditional. It now says the hearer takes it as a conditional awaiting an apodosis or as a negative that inverts the meaning, so the emphasis is lost.

المسألة: «إمالة» is a technical term of qirā'āt and tajwīd: tilting a fatḥa or alif toward kasra or yā'. It does not mean replacing one consonant with another. Using it here for ḍād becoming dāl misuses the term in a chapter on Quranic recitation.
البيان: The heading now reads «تقريب الضاد من الدال», and «إمالة» is gone.

المسألة: The «الناس» wording is itself transmitted. Al-Nasa'i and Ahmad relate from Abu Hurayra: «المسلم من سلم الناس من لسانه ويده، والمؤمن من أمنه الناس على دمائهم وأموالهم». So treating «الناس» as a lexical error (◔) and calling it a widening of the hadith's wording erases a real variant. The card should say the variant exists and make the point about citing one riwāya precisely, instead of calling the other wording wrong.
البيان: The ✘ form is now «سلم الناس» attributed to «متفق عليه». The explanation now says al-Nasa'i and Ahmad relate the «الناس» wording from Abu Hurayra, so the error is mixing the two riwāyāt. Seen on Shamela, Risala eds.; the body names the collections without numbers.

المسألة: This contradicts the lexicons. Al-Jawhari and «جمهور أهل اللغة», as al-Nawawi reports them, say «آمين في الدعاء يمد ويقصر»: the short form أَمِينَ is a recognised variant of the same word, not the adjective أمين. Calling it a ● «قاتل» error that turns the supplication into a description is unfounded. (Also «الثقة الأمانة» is garbled.)
البيان: The آمين card is rewritten. The lexicons say آمين in supplication «تُمدّ وتُقصر» (al-Jawhari via al-Nawawi; Mukhtar al-Sihah, checked on Shamela). Short أمين is now a recognised variant, «خلاف الأشهر», rated ○ هنة instead of ● قاتل, and the title and the hearer row were adjusted.

المسألة: Cards 15 to 18 quote prophetic adhkār word for word as the ✔ form: «سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ», «بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا», «الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ», «سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ / الْأَعْلَى», «لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ». المسألة: This overstates the rule. When «لا» is repeated, grammarians allow five readings, among them «لا حولَ ولا قوةً» (the second noun in the accusative with tanwīn, joined to the first noun's position). The ✘ form «لا حَوْلًا ولا قوةً» is wrong only because of the tanwīn on the first noun. The instruction that neither noun may take nasb with tanwīn, and «احفظ الذكر… بلا تنوين على الاسمين», treats a permitted reading as an error.
البيان: The rule is now stated correctly. The first noun after لا النافية للجنس is built on fatḥ with no tanwīn. The second, after the repeated لا, allows several readings, and the formula's preserved wording has fatḥ, so tanwīn on the second departs from the formula without breaking grammar.

المسألة: The drill mixes a Quranic verse («إنما المؤمنون إخوة», al-Hujurat 10) and a hadith («إنما الصبر عند الصدمة الأولى») with ordinary drill sentences. None is marked, referenced or sourced, so the reader cannot tell a verse or hadith from an invented example. The Quran here is not in ﴿﴾ either.
البيان: Three drill sentences replaced with invented «إنما» sentences: an unmarked verse (al-Hujurat 10), a hadith, and «إنما العلم بالتعلم», itself a hadith fragment.

المسألة: The grammatical analysis is wrong. The mufassirūn and muʿribūn parse «ما شاء الله» (al-Kahf 39) as a relative «ما» in the nominative, predicate of an omitted subject («هي/الأمر ما شاء الله»), or as a conditional with the apodosis omitted («ما شاء الله كان»). Exclamatory «ما» needs the «ما أفعلَه» pattern. The same wrong label appears at line 216 («ما» التعجبية) and line 221.
البيان: ما in «ما شاء الله» is now parsed as relative (هذا ما شاء الله) or conditional (ما شاء الله كان), not exclamatory. Lines 216, 217 and 221 were rewritten together.

المسألة: The nasb «الحمدَ لله» is a recognised iʿrāb: a maṣdar governed by an understood verb («أحمدُ الحمدَ»). It is also cited as a shādhdh reading of al-Fatiha 2. It is not a violation of the rules. Outside recitation of the Mushaf it is grammatically valid. The explanation should say it goes against the established wording of the formula and the reading of the Mushaf, not that it breaks the grammar.
البيان: The الحمدَ nasb card now says nasb is a valid iʿrāb with an understood verb, and the fault is departing from the fixed wording of the formula and the Mushaf. The card stays ○.

المسألة: Two errors that recur through the qāf cards (lines 113, 117, 125, 135, 146 to 150). (1) In the classical tradition qāf comes from «أقصى اللسان وما فوقه من الحنك», not «أقصى الحلق», which is the place of hamza and hā'. (2) Qāf is classed «مجهور» in Sibawayh's system, but the standard qāf of present-day recitation and speech is described by modern Arab phoneticians as voiceless. The card's advice to «تحسّس اهتزاز حلقك» to tell qāf from kāf would train a voiced [ɢ]. The classical and modern descrip
البيان: The qāf cards follow Bible decision 8 (the modern recited norm). Qāf is placed at أقصى اللسان وما فوقه من الحنك; kāf slightly lower and forward. The «feel the throat vibrate» advice is replaced by a breath test (breath held for qāf, flowing for kāf).

المسألة: This is phonetically inverted. Hamza is the deepest sound («أقصى الحلق», the glottis), lower than qāf, not «أعلى». Line 162 repeats the error for ʿayn: «والهمزة صوت انفجاري من الحنجرة أعلى منه قليلًا». ʿAyn is from وسط الحلق, above the glottis.
البيان: Line 125: hamza is now from أقصى الحلق, deeper than qāf («أعمق منه بمسافة واضحة»), and qāf is from أقصى اللسان. The drill on line 129 is aligned.

المسألة: The place labels are wrong. Ghayn and khā' come from «أدنى الحلق», and qāf from أقصى اللسان. Line 209 to 210 likewise says «الخاء أشد احتكاكًا من أقصاه», meaning أقصى الحلق. Line 221 gives khā' «استطالة», a ṣifa that belongs only to ḍād.
البيان: Lines 136, 209, 213 and 221: ghayn and khā' are now from أدنى الحلق, and qāf is no longer called a throat letter. Line 220's «استطالة» for ḥā' is replaced.

المسألة: Qāf and ḥā' are not muṭbaq letters; the iṭbāq letters are only ص ض ط ظ. Line 236 likewise calls ḍ/ẓ «حرف حلقي مطبق», but they are not guttural.
البيان: Line 256 now says «أصوات الضاد والقاف والحاء» with no إطباق claim, and line 236 says «حرف مطبق بعد حاء».

المسألة: The chapter describes ḍād in two incompatible ways without separating them. Lines 39, 51 and 61 give the modern realisation: an apical stop at the upper incisors like dāl. Lines 54, 63 and 65 give the classical lateral ḍād («حافته», «مخرج الضاد الجانبي»). A learner told to do both gets contradictory instructions. The chapter should state that the classical description (lateral, Sibawayh) and today's recitation (stop) differ, and choose which one to train.
البيان: Lines 54, 63, 65 and 81 now use the modern ḍād (tongue tip at the roots of the upper incisors) that lines 39, 51 and 61 already gave, per Bible decision 8. The lateral-ḍād and «حافة اللسان» wording is removed.

المسألة: «بحث» also takes a direct object in the accepted sense of «examined, studied» (بحث الأمرَ/المسألةَ), and this is recorded in the standard modern lexicon. «بحثتُ الموضوعَ طويلًا» (I studied the topic at length) is therefore correct. The proposed correction «بحثتُ عن الموضوعِ» (I searched for the topic) changes the meaning, which inverts the card. The line-159 claim that بحث is «لازم لا يتعدى إلا بحرف جر» is also inaccurate. A different example (e.g. رغب في) would be safe.
البيان: Card 12's example is now «اهتممتُ الموضوعَ» ✘ / «اهتممتُ بالموضوعِ» ✔ (اهتمّ takes only بـ). The rule list and drill no longer present بحث as intransitive.

المسألة: «وجب» overstates the rule. «لولاي/لولاك/لولاه» (with an attached pronoun) is attested and accepted by Sibawayh and many grammarians. The Kufans hold it is in the nominative position, and the question is a known khilāf (al-Insaf, mas'ala 97). «لولا إياك» is wrong, but the rule as stated wrongly excludes لولاك.
البيان: The لولا rule is limited to separate pronouns. It now notes that «لولاك/لولاي» is attested, that Sibawayh accepted it, and that its parsing is a known khilāf; «إياك» remains wrong.

المسألة: The numbers 3 to 10 are العدد المفرد, not المركّب (compounds are 11 to 19). Card 14 (line 176) names them correctly («العدد المفرد من ٣ إلى ١٠»). Line 63 is also garbled («عدد مؤنث (بلا تاء) مع معدود مذكر لا، بل العكس تمامًا»).
البيان: The heading says «العدد المفرد من ٣ إلى ١٠», and line 63 is no longer garbled.

The exclamation is a pragmatic use, not the grammatical type. The same claim is repeated in line 217 («ما» هنا للتعجب) and in the drill in line 221. All three lines need rewording.

المسألة: The card labels «الله غافرٌ» an error. Line 51 then says the form is «أضعف مما يقتضيه مقام الثناء على الله بأسمائه الحسنى». Yet the Quran itself praises God with the form غافر (﴿غَافِرِ الذَّنبِ﴾, غافر: ٣, and ﴿خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ﴾, الأعراف: ١٥٥). So presenting غافر as a weaker or faulty choice when praising God is a theological and linguistic claim that the Quranic text contradicts. البيان: The غافر/غفور card now teaches a difference in shade, not an error. It cites ﴿غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ﴾ (غافر: ٣), set in Uthmani with the quran.py functions, and says both forms are sound praise of God. ✘ is limited to contexts meant to stress abundant forgiveness, and the card stays ○ هنة.

The rule at line 167 («يعود في الغالب إلى الأقرب ما لم يمنع مانع») also leaves out that case agreement is exactly the مانع here. البيان: The case vowel on «الجديد» was dropped (as in pause), which settles the ambiguity point.

المسألة: «القناعة كنز لا يفنى» is a fixed, well-known wording. It circulates widely as a marfu' Prophetic hadith whose authenticity is contested; this is from general knowledge and has not been checked against an edition, so it needs verification before any note is written. Here a fictional speaker utters it as a piece of wisdom. It is not in the quotation ledger and has no note. A reader who knows it as «a hadith» will take the book to be passing it on unmarked, in a series that grades every report. There are two options: (a) verify it with shamela.py/hadith.py and add a functional note on its status;
البيان: Verified on Shamela: al-Bayhaqī, al-Zuhd al-kabīr, reports «القناعة كنز لا يفنى» marfūʿ and says «هذا إسناد ضعيف». Replaced the character's line with an original line keeping the ق target («القَناعَةُ رِزْقٌ يَقي صاحِبَهُ القَلَقَ»).

المسألة: The vocalization gives the wrong word. The causal فاء («فما تحدّث إلا بإذن») and the مجلس العلم setting require «ضبط نَفْسَه» (self-restraint, a fixed idiom). The text vocalizes «نَفَسَه» (his breath), which does not motivate speaking only with permission and is not an idiom. Read aloud, the learner says a different word from the one meant.
البيان: Day 15 (sound review, مجلس العلم adab context, causal فاء) → «ضَبَطَ نَفْسَهُ»; l.315 «ضَبْطِ نَفَسِهِ» left as an intentional breath reading.

المسألة: A broad historical claim («غزير», «قرونًا», four named fields) is stated as fact with no source. The book's rule requires historical facts from their primary source and without generalisation. No row in the ledger or JSON covers it, so either document it on a seen printed reference or narrow it to what can be documented. No citation is proposed here, so as not to supply one from memory.
البيان: Removed the undocumented quantifiers («غزير»، «قرونًا»). The sentence now just says West African scholars wrote in Arabic in these fields, with no claim of scale.

المسألة: Read with the table that follows, the text implies Arabic repetition serves only distribution and succession. The table row at line 268 then lists «رفع الصوت والتكرار» as the transferred, non-Arabic way of emphasising a statement. But classical grammar has a whole chapter on التوكيد اللفظي, emphasis by repeating a word. The real contrast is repetition to express degree or quantity («صعب صعب»), which the passage should name precisely.
البيان: The text now says Arabic knows التوكيد اللفظي as well as distributive repetition, and the verse is introduced as an example of the latter. The table's transferred pattern now reads «رفع الصوت، وتكرار الكلمة في كل جملة», with no absolute claim added.

المسألة: The note gives only al-Nawawi's attribution to al-Husayn, which makes the formula a Companion's athar. The older sources give a nearly identical formula from al-Hasan al-Basri. The disputed attribution is not shown. No fix is proposed: the older sources were seen only in digital copies. Verify Musnad Ibn al-Ja'd or Ibn Abi al-Dunya's al-'Iyal on a print first. Then add «ويُروى نحوه عن الحسن البصري» with its source.
القرار: رُدّ (ليس خطأً أو هو قرارٌ مقصود)
البيان: Footnote 5 faithfully reports al-Adhkar p.453 (confirmed on scan) and the main text does not present the formula as a Companion's report. Adding the al-Hasan al-Basri variant would first need Musnad Ibn al-Ja'd / al-'Iyal checked on a print, so nothing was added.

المسألة: «أطنب» is intransitive (أطنب في الكلام); unlike «أوجز الكلامَ», it does not take a direct object. The chapter repeatedly uses it with one: ف09-أ line 17 «يطنب فكرة موجزة»; ف09-ب line 10 «يطنب فكرة موجزة»; line 214 «ما يوجزه وما يطنبه»; line 287 «متمهلة للمطنب»; line 344 «أطنب فكرة موجزة»; line 357 «أطنب: «القراءة مفيدة.»»; line 386 «وأطنب الخمس الأخرى». Vol. 4 uses the correct form, «أطنب في نقد جهة سابقة».
البيان: «أطنب» is intransitive (أطنب في الكلام), so the volume's transitive uses were corrected: ف09-أ:17; ف09-ب:10, 126, 214, 344, 386; «للمطنب» at 287 was reworded. The list label «٤. أطنب: «القراءة مفيدة.»» (357) is left as a colon label, not a governed object.

المسألة: The exercise asks the learner to place pause and stress marks, but items 1–3 (lines 289–291) already have them, along with speed labels, so there is nothing left to do. المسألة: The scene presents this as خطبة الحاجة, and the analysis at line 204 calls it «أُديت كاملة وصحيحة… التمهيد المأثور». The wording drops the opening «إنّ» of the transmitted text. Everywhere else in this volume the formula is written «إنّ الحمد لله، نحمده ونستعينه…». Line 185 (س٣ of the first dialogue) has the same omission: «الحمد لله نحمده ونستعينه...».
البيان: The improved recitation of khutbat al-haja (ف03-ج s3) now opens «إنَّ الحمدَ للهِ، …», as in every verified version (Muslim 868, Abu Dawud 2118, al-Tirmidhi 1105) and the volume's own ch. 2, since the analysis calls the recitation complete and correct.

المسألة: The line is labelled «خطبة الحاجة كاملة» and later judged «صحيحة» (line 204), but it omits the opening «إنّ» of the transmitted formula.
البيان: Same fix in the first dialogue (ف03-ج l.185): «إنّ الحمد لله، نحمده ونستعينه...».

المسألة: The activity is titled 'the four elements' and promises «افتتاح كامل», but it uses groups of three and builds only three elements; the fourth, خريطة الطريق, is dropped. The learner is left unsure whether the result counts as complete.
البيان: The «سباق العناصر الأربعة» activity now uses groups of four and builds all four elements, adding «خريطة طريق», as its title and «افتتاح كامل» promise.

المسألة: The improved version does not model the fix the analysis asks for. L91 faults Bilal, the speaker being trained, for not preparing how to open the call («وهذا مما ينبغي أن يستحضره المتكلم قبل أن يُسأل عنه»). In the improved dialogue the director still supplies it (س٩, L107: «فابدأْ بالسؤالِ عن حالِه بلطفٍ»), and the table credits the change to her. The learner never sees Bilal do it.
البيان: In the improved dialogue of ف07-ب, the director now asks how Bilal will open the call, and Bilal answers with the gentle opening himself (s9–s10). The «ماذا تغيّر؟» row was updated to match, so the model now shows the preparation the analysis (L91) asks for.

المسألة: A classical proverb is given, in a chapter about exact wording, in a shortened form without «لك», and it is not in the ledger. The classical collections list it as a مثل, in the form «رُبَّ أخٍ لك لم تلده أمك», attributed to Luqman b. 'Ad and narrated as a saying of al-Hasan. The book calls it «حكمة» with no known speaker.
القرار: رُدّ (ليس خطأً أو هو قرارٌ مقصود)
البيان: The ✔ model gives the common modern wording and deliberately attributes it to no one, which is the chapter's own rule. The «لك» variant and the مثل/حكمة classification rest only on a digital copy of مجمع الأمثال, and the chapter's definition of حكمة (known or unknown speaker) covers the usage. Not an error.

المسألة: The preposition is wrong. تصدّر takes its object directly (تصدّر المجلسَ/القائمةَ). «تصدّر على» is not an attested construction, and the intended meaning is «did not take precedence over it». The same wording appears in ف09-ب l.347.
البيان: «ولم يتصدر عليه» → «ولم يتقدّم عليه» (تصدّر takes its object directly; the intended meaning is precedence).

المسألة: Same collocation error as ف09-أ l.175: تصدّر does not take «على». The intended meaning is «took precedence over».
البيان: «أم تصدر عليه؟» → «أم تقدّم عليه؟», matching F371.

المسألة: The chapter gives no criterion to answer this quiz item, and its two statements conflict. The rule at ف10-ب l.5 says: if in doubt about the wording or the attribution, «فاترك البيت كله». Six lines later (l.11), when in doubt, it offers two equal options: leave it, or «تقدّمه بصيغة تُعلن عدم يقينك». Nothing says when each applies.
البيان: Added one sentence to ف10-ب l.11 that reconciles the rule and the hedged alternative. Leaving the verse out is the default the rule requires, and the hedge is allowed only in an informal setting where the verse is a passing allusion. Quiz 6 is now answerable.

المسألة: The objectives all complete the stem «يكون المتدرب قادرًا على أن:». This one switches to a new subject (الأخت), so it reads «قادرًا على أن تهدئ الأخت أختها» and no longer fits the stem or the other objectives.
البيان: Objective 2 recast to complete the stem with the learner as subject while keeping the sister-to-sister scope: «يؤدي لسان الأخت التي تهدّئ أختها الغاضبة أو الحزينة…».

المسألة: The chapter's characters contradict each other. In ف04-أ line 36, Yusuf is the middle son «في المرحلة الثانوية». Here he is a third-year university student (line 90: «في السنةِ الثالثةِ ... مع يوسفَ»), and his father is named Ibrahim. Exercise 10.3 (line 218) and quiz 10 (line 295) tie this Yusuf to the Yusuf of the opening scene. His brother Bilal, who is older than him (ف04-ب line 29), is only in his second year. A learner following the chapter's family will be confused.
القرار: رُدّ (ليس خطأً أو هو قرارٌ مقصود)
البيان: The opening scene family (father, mother, Omar, Yusuf) and the guest-dialogue family (Ibrahim, Khadija, Hafsa, Yusuf) are separate illustrative families; nothing in the text identifies them, and quiz 10 refers only to the opening scene.

المسألة: The full «successful» model for addressing the university president makes two requests in a five-minute meeting: financial support and attendance at the opening. The lesson's own table (line 127) lists «عرض أكثر من طلب واحد في لقاء قصير» among the phrases to avoid.
القرار: رُدّ (ليس خطأً أو هو قرارٌ مقصود)
البيان: The invitation to the opening is a courtesy closing the single support request, not a second agenda item; the author's model stands.

المسألة: The addressee named does not match the cited verse. The wording of the verse is correct (مطابقة-القرآن.json: «مطابق»), but النساء: ٥ is about السفهاء: «وَلَا تُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلسُّفَهَآءَ أَمْوَٰلَكُمُ … وَقُولُوا۟ لَهُمْ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا». The verse that names اليتامى and المساكين is النساء: ٨ («وَإِذَا حَضَرَ ٱلْقِسْمَةَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينُ … قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا»). As written, the book assigns the Quranic context wrongly.
البيان: Reference corrected from (النساء: ٥), which concerns السفهاء, to (النساء: ٨), which names اليتامى والمساكين with the identical words «قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوفًا» (checked against the Uthmani cache; quran.py reports all 236 citations مطابق).

المسألة: The author's framing is stated as a fact about the verses, and it is inaccurate. The speakers differ: Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh (طه ٤٤), the believers (الأحزاب ٧٠), the son to his parents (الإسراء ٢٣). «إبلاغ الحق» is also not the purpose of «قولًا كريمًا» to parents or «قولًا ميسورًا» to someone in need. Line 40 already says the grouping of the verses is the author's own pedagogical observation. This clause should say only what that observation needs: the act, speech, is the same.
البيان: Deleted the inaccurate clause «مع أن القائل واحد والغاية واحدة: إبلاغ الحق»; the next paragraph already states «ستة أوصاف لفعل واحد هو القول».

المسألة: الملاحظة موضوعة بعد موقفَي الإعلام (١٣–١٤) لا قبلهما، ومع ذلك تقول «ننتقل الآن» من الميادين الأربعة الأولى إلى الإعلام والمقام الرسمي؛ وسائر ملاحظات الانتقال تصل ميدانًا منتهيًا بالذي يليه. فالانتقال المعلن هنا قد وقع قبلها.
البيان: Transition note reworded to fit its position after the media situations: «من الإعلام إلى المقام الرسمي نبقى في ميادين…», following the pattern of the other notes.

المسألة: معيار الإتقان لا يتسق مع الهدف ٣ ولا مع بنك المواقف. الهدف ٣ يطلب جملة الوصل «في عشرة مقامات مختلفة على الأقل». والبنك فيه عشرة مواقف، لكن ملاحظة المدرب (السطر ٧١٧) تنص على أن المواقف ٤ و٥ و٦ و٧ و٩ «يُقاس [فيها] الاستماع لا الكلام»، فلا يبقى للسلام وجملة الوصل إلا خمسة مواقف، وهي أقل من الثمانية التي يطلبها المعيار.
البيان: Mastery criterion now «في ثمانية مقامات من بنك المواقف وتدريبات الفصل», since the trainer note leaves only five speaking situations in the bank.

المسألة: Objective 5 of this lesson (line 13) and the checklist in ف05-ج line 291 ask the learner to tell formulas established by the text from customary ones. This table does not make that distinction. It mixes a Qur'anic phrase (الاسترجاع), a fragment of the Prophet's janaza prayer (اللهم اغفر له وارحمه), formulas reported from later scholars (عظّم الله أجركم…), and purely colloquial custom (البقية في حياتكم) under one label, so the reader cannot tell which is which.
البيان: Added a sentence after the condolence-formula table separating text-based formulas (istirja', the janaza du'a, both established earlier in the lesson) from the rest as good custom not attributed to the Prophet ﷺ.

المسألة: Objective 2, repeated in the mastery criterion at line 784, sets a measure of «ثمانية أمثلة من عشرة». The chapter has no set of ten examples or exercise that asks the learner to sort مداراة, مداهنة, تملق and مدح صادق. None of the eleven exercise groups or the short test provides it. The criterion cannot be measured from the chapter.
القرار: رُدّ (ليس خطأً أو هو قرارٌ مقصود)
البيان: The 'ثمانية من عشرة' measure is a trainer-administered assessment (answer keys and assessment models are in the teacher's guide, ف03 l.815); the chapter's exercises and quiz address the distinction. A curriculum choice, not an error.

المسألة: The lesson objective asks for at least eight addressees. The lesson's application table («التطبيقات: المعنى الواحد بحسب المخاطَب والرسمية») gives only five (father, friend, teacher, manager, unknown official), and chapter objective 3 names no number. The objective and the content do not match.
البيان: Lesson objective 3 now asks for «خمسة مخاطَبين», matching the lesson's application table (five addressees).

المسألة: The lesson never delivers this objective. The only such distinction it draws is for the Eid greeting «تقبل الله منا ومنك» (line 29). The condolence formulas table (lines 93–99) mixes «أحسن الله عزاءكم» and «البقية في حياتكم» with the prophetic «اللهم اغفر له وارحمه» without saying which rests on a text and which is custom. The self-check list (ف05-ج line 291) and the trainer notes (line 354) nonetheless assume the learner can make this distinction.
البيان: Resolved by the same added sentence as F381, which now delivers objective 5 inside the lesson.

المسألة: This is the only hadith in the heritage section with no takhrij note. The ones around it (notes 3, 4 and 5) give the collection, number and chapter. The ledger already holds the verified data, so the note can be written without guessing. Adding it requires running pdf/renumber.py afterwards.
البيان: Added takhrij note for «إن أبغض الرجال إلى الله الألد الخصم»: Bukhari 2457 (Kitab al-Mazalim, bab qawl Allah ﴿وهو ألد الخصام﴾) and Muslim 2668 (Kitab al-Ilm, bab fi al-aladd al-khasim), checked on Shamela and matching verified ledger row م٦-٠١٨; notes renumbered.

المسألة: The narration places the phrase in «الفصول التي عقدها للملكة اللسانية» (Ibn Khaldun's later chapters on language as a habit). The verified location is the علم النحو subsection of the chapter on علوم اللسان العربي (ch. 45, 1/754), which is what footnote 1 itself says. The ledger note also records that an earlier wrong placement of this phrase was corrected. The model answers ③ and ④ repeat the imprecise placement («في فصوله عن الملكة اللسانية»), and the ledger has no row for this position (م٦ ف٠٦); the text is verified only at م١-٠٦١.
البيان: Narration and models ③/④ now place the phrase in Ibn Khaldun's discussion of علم النحو within علوم اللسان العربي (verified on Shamela 12320, 1/754, matching note 1 and ledger م١-٠٦١), not in the chapters on the linguistic malaka.

المسألة: Examples مث١٢ and مث١٣ (line 73: «موظفة تلاحظ زميلها مرهقًا من ضغط العمل») sit under the heading «ثلاثة سلوكيات تكسب المحبة في المجتمع». They are workplace scenes and illustrate none of the three society behaviours in the table (accepting invitations, following up, remembering details). The domain split this lesson is built on becomes blurred for the learner.
البيان: Inserted the label «ومثالان آخران من بيئة العمل:» before مث١٢ so the two workplace examples no longer sit unmarked under the society heading; IDs and order untouched.

المسألة: «أيه» is unclear and reads as colloquial («إيه»). It also has no plural antecedent: «احتمال واحد» is singular, but «أيّ» here asks which of several possibilities is meant.
البيان: «لا تدري أيه المقصود» → «لا تدري أيُّ الاحتمالات هو المقصود».

المسألة: The lesson does not deliver this objective. The «with four addressees» section (lines 220–236) covers شيخ، زميل، طالب، اجتماع رسمي. The angry person gets one example (مث١٢) and the hurried person is covered indirectly (مث١٨), but clarifying with a specialist or with a layperson (العامي) is never taught. The self-check list in ف03-ب line 232 still asks for it.
البيان: Objective 5 (ف03-أ) and the matching self-check item (ف03-ب l.232) now name the addressees the chapter actually teaches (senior, peer, junior, formal meeting, angry, hurried) instead of the untaught specialist/layperson.

المسألة: The explanation names the four-part «لا أدري» rule but lists three different components. The chapter defines it as الإقرار، وما تعرفه، ومن يعرف، والوعد (line 310). The table misstates the rule it cites.
البيان: The table cell no longer calls the three listed steps «الرباعية»; it now reads «من قاعدة «لا أدري»: إقرار، ودلالة على من يعرف، ثم الجواب بعد التثبّت».

المسألة: This is a juristic reading stated as if it were the plain meaning of the hadith. The hadith's own condition is استطاعة; restricting action «by hand» to those with authority (ولاية) is a scholarly elaboration, and scholars have stated it in different ways. It is given as settled fact with no source, only the general pointer «مبسوطة في كتب الفقه». Attributing the restriction to the scholars keeps the substance without presenting an interpretation as the text itself.
البيان: The تنبيه now distinguishes the hadith's own condition (الاستطاعة) from the restriction to ولاية/صلاحية, which is attributed to «كثير من أهل العلم».

المسألة: No speaker can say this model sentence coherently. If Yusuf says it, «هذا يوسف … في سنته» refers to himself in the third person. If the father says it, as the bracket suggests, he cannot address his own brother as «يا عمي». The model self-introduction is therefore inconsistent with its stated speaker.
البيان: Only the bracket was incoherent: «[أو يقولها الأب عن ابنه]» -> «[يقولها أحد إخوته]» (a brother can say «يا عمي، ابن أخيك»). The model sentence is unchanged.

المسألة: In the model answer to a grammar examiner, «الإضمار» (as opposed to «الحذف») is defined as putting a pronoun in place of an explicit noun. In the grammatical terminology the examiner is asking about, إضمار is an element dropped from the wording but kept in intent, with an effect (for example «أن مضمرة», «على إضمار فعل»), not pronominal substitution. The «successful» answer confuses two technical senses. This is my own reasoning and needs checking: confirm on print, for example in al-Jurjānī's التعريفات (s.v. الإضمار), which is already in this volume's source list.
القرار: رُدّ (ليس خطأً أو هو قرارٌ مقصود)
البيان: Pronominalisation is an attested technical sense of الإضمار set against الحذف. Ibn Malik, شواهد التوضيح (ed. Taha Muhsin, p.180 on shamela 98123) draws exactly this line in tanazu': «وظهر الفرق بين الحذف والإضمار بالتثنية والجمع… ضرباني… ويقال على الحذف: ضربني».

المسألة: The cross-reference probably points to the wrong example. مث٣ contrasts self-boasting (✘ «أنا خريج جامعة مرموقة…») with modest self-introduction; it shows no flattery. The example that contrasts over-praise with balanced respect is مث١٣: ✘ «هنا أفضل بكثير من مكاني السابق في كل شيء» / ✔ «لكل مكان ما يميزه…».
البيان: Cross-reference [مث٣] (self-praise) changed to [مث١٣], whose ✘/✔ actually contrast over-praise with measured praise.

المسألة: The phrase contrasts زمن with معنى, which is incoherent because tense is part of a verb's meaning. It also repeats the same flawed idea as the criterion above.

المسألة: This is a claim about hadith transmission: that another version in both Sahihs gives the reason for the prohibition. It has no takhrij and no ledger row. المسألة: The rule leaves out the condition that the first letter be sakin, and states as unsupported fact that 'the fluent tongue' tends to merge the two letters. Merging two voweled identical letters across words is al-idghām al-kabīr, characteristic of Abū ʿAmr's reading (al-Sūsī). It is not the norm the book teaches elsewhere: Ḥafṣ-based recitation, and ch. 8's rule that short vowels are pronounced in full («والقِصر غير الاختلاس»). The obligatory, standard case is first letter sakin («مِن نُّور»). The same rule recurs in the lesson objective (l. 213), the تنبيه (l. 294), and ف09-ب lines 227 and 258.
البيان: Sukun condition now in rule (l.284), objective (l.213), تنبيه (l.294) and ف09-ب checklist; مث١٨ replaced by «هلْ لكم» (first-round v02). ف09-ب summary l.258 names the defined concept and was left.

If the rule is softened, the author may also want to reconsider the ✘ marking of «اللجنة اجتمعوا» (مث٧).
البيان: Rule now says singular agreement is the more common and preferred usage in formal speech, while agreement by meaning is allowed in fasih Arabic (cf. al-Hujurat 9, al-Baqara 146). مث٧ «اللجنة اجتمعوا» moved from ✘ to ◐ (acceptable but can be improved), «خطأ آخر» became «موضعٌ آخر», and in ف02-ج:156 «والصواب» became «والمختار».

المسألة: This is stated as an absolute rule, but the plural demonstrative (أولاء / هؤلاء / أولئك) also refers to non-rational plurals in classical usage, including the Qur'an. The masdar of verbs beginning with hamzat al-wasl is formed by giving the third letter a kasra and adding an alif before the last letter (استخرج ← استخراج، اتّصل ← اتّصال), as the chapter's own examples show.

In fact these are hollow verbs: the masdar lost its middle letter (استشوار ← استشارة) and the ta compensates for it (تاء العوض). The pattern is اسْتِفالة, not اسْتِفْعال.

المسألة: This gives a fiqh-methodology ruling as settled fact. That a weak hadith is no proof for a legal ruling is broadly agreed. But «لا يجوز» extended to «أدب اجتماعي» (manners and virtues) presents one strict position as the only one. Many scholars accepted a narration that is not severely weak in فضائل الأعمال والآداب, under conditions. The standard requires disputed questions to be shown in proportion. The chapter's practical advice (the table row and مث٩) can stay as advice without the categorical ruling.
